info.name: 🧾 Smart Expense Tracker API
info.description:
Complete API collection for Smart Expense Tracker built with Spring Boot, JWT Auth, MySQL.

Author: Rahul Chauhan
GitHub: github.com/rahul-323/smart-expense-tracker

## Setup Instructions:
1. Import this collection into Postman
2. The `base_url` variable is pre-set to `http://localhost:8080/api`
3. Register a user first, then login — JWT token is AUTO-SAVED
4. All authenticated endpoints automatically use the saved token

## Variable Reference:
- `{{base_url}}` → API base URL
- `{{jwt_token}}` → Auto-saved after login/register
- `{{user_id}}` → Auto-saved after login/register
- `{{category_id}}` → Set manually or from response
- `{{expense_id}}` → Set manually or from response
- `{{income_id}}` → Set manually or from response
- `{{budget_id}}` → Set manually or from response
- `{{recurring_id}}` → Set manually or from response

item.name: 📂 Categories
item.description:
Category management — 14 default categories + user custom categories.
All endpoints require JWT authentication.

Returns only the 14 system default categories.
Returns only the custom categories created by the logged-in user.
Get a single category by its ID. Must be a default category or belong to the current user.
Create a new custom category for the logged-in user. Category ID is AUTO-SAVED.
Update a custom category. Cannot update default (system) categories.
Soft-delete a custom category (sets isActive=false). Cannot delete default categories.
Test: Should return 409 Conflict — default category with this name already exists.
Test: Should return 400 Bad Request — cannot modify default categories.
Test: Should return 400 Bad Request — cannot delete default categories.

item.name: 💸 Expenses
item.description:
Expense CRUD with filtering, pagination, search, and budget impact.
All endpoints require JWT authentication.

request.description:
Create a new expense. Links to a category. Tags are auto-created if they don't exist.
Expense ID is AUTO-SAVED.

body.raw:
{
    "amount": 450.0,
    "description": "Lunch at Vaishali Restaurant",
    "note": "Team lunch with Girish and Deepak",
    "expenseDate": "2026-06-15",
    "categoryId": 1,
    "paymentMethod": "UPI",
    "status": "CONFIRMED",
    "tagNames": [
        "food",
        "office"
    ]
}

request.description: Sample: Rent expense
Sample: Transport expense
Sample: Subscription expense

Get all expenses for the logged-in user with pagination and sorting.

Params:
- page: Page number (0-indexed)
- size: Items per page
- sortBy: Field to sort by (expenseDate, amount, createdAt)
- sortDir: asc or desc
Get a single expense by its ID. Must belong to the current user.
Update an existing expense. Recalculates budget if amount or category changes.

body.raw:
{
    "amount": 500.0,
    "description": "Lunch at Vaishali Restaurant (updated)",
    "note": "Team lunch \u2014 bill was higher than expected",
    "expenseDate": "2026-06-15",
    "categoryId": 1,
    "paymentMethod": "UPI",
    "status": "CONFIRMED",
    "tagNames": [
        "food",

        "team"

}

item.name: 📊 Budgets
item.description:
Budget management — set spending limits per category per month.
All endpoints require JWT authentication.

request.description:
Set a monthly budget for a category. Alert when spending crosses the threshold %.
Budget ID is AUTO-SAVED.
Sample: Transport budget for June 2026
Sample: Rent budget for June 2026
Sample: Subscriptions budget
Get all budgets set by the user for the current month.
Get a single budget entry by its ID.
Get all budgets for a specific month/year.

⭐ KEY ENDPOINT: Returns budget status for each category — limit, spent, remaining, percentage, status (ON_TRACK / WARNING / EXCEEDED).

Example response:
[
  {
    "category": "Food & Dining",
    "budgetLimit": 5000,
    "spentAmount": 3800,
    "remainingAmount": 1200,
    "percentUsed": 76,
    "status": "ON_TRACK"
  }
]
Update budget limit or alert threshold.
Delete a budget entry.
Test: Should return 409 Conflict — budget already exists for this category/month.

item.name: 🔄 Recurring Expenses

Manage recurring expenses (subscriptions, rent, EMI, etc.).
Scheduler auto-creates expenses based on frequency.
All endpoints require JWT authentication.

request.description:
Create a recurring expense. Scheduler will auto-create expense entries based on frequency.
Recurring ID is AUTO-SAVED.
Sample: Gym recurring expense with end date
Sample: Rent recurring expense (no end date = indefinite)
Get all recurring expenses for the logged-in user.
Get a single recurring expense by its ID.
Update a recurring expense (e.g., price increase).
Toggle active/inactive status. Paused recurring expenses won't generate new expenses.
Delete a recurring expense. Previously generated expenses are NOT deleted.

item.name: 📈 Dashboard
item.description:
Analytics and summary endpoints — monthly summary, category breakdown, trends, top expenses.
All endpoints require JWT authentication.

Get financial summary for a specific month/year.

Day-wise expense totals for a specific month. Useful for bar/line charts.
Get the top 5 highest expenses for the current month.
